Hi Ayla,

Thanks for agreeing to proceed with Redwood. To get HelioTech set up in our vendor master and enable PO routing, can you send the following:

- Legal business name (exact as on tax documents)
- Tax ID / EIN
- Registered address for remittance
- Primary AP contact (name, email, phone)
- Billing email for invoices (if different)
- W-9 or equivalent tax form
- Bank remit details (ACH form or bank letter)
- Beneficial owner declaration (or a link to your compliance portal)

Once we have those we'll:

1) Create the vendor master record
2) Provision a vendor portal account so you can upload invoices
3) Confirm PO routing and send the first PO

Target turnaround for production-ready status is 3 business days after receiving complete docs. Please attach the W-9 and bank remit when convenient.

Thanks,
